verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform that ships a CLI, MCP server and AI agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out setting. Bring Your Own Models and files staying on the agent's disk are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
